notes: Inspected the 1536x1024 implementation capture recorded above for v0.1.0-alpha.2. Asserted geometry is unchanged and still passes at 1536x1024 and 1024x768. Scope: the implementation capture itself, not a pixel diff against the concept art, which remains on file at docs/design/intern-primary-screen.png.
